models.notes: Superseded by gpt-5.6-sol/gpt-5.6-terra. Disabled rather than deleted so past benchmark history referencing this id still resolves. Its 30K TPM cap made it unreliable for large-book adaptation (see issue-27).

Replaces gpt-4o. Confirmed live via direct OpenAI API call: reasoning-family model, rejects non-default temperature (GrokChatClient self-heals by retrying without it). maxInputTokens=400,000 and max output=128,000 per published spec. Pricing is still an unverified placeholder copied from gpt-4o — update when a real source is available. One of three gpt-5.6 variants (sol/terra/luna) in this account; no plain gpt-5.6 exists.

Replaces gpt-4o alongside gpt-5.6-sol. Confirmed live via direct OpenAI API call: reasoning-family model, rejects non-default temperature (GrokChatClient self-heals by retrying without it). maxInputTokens is officially unpublished by OpenAI (unlike Sol's 400,000 and Luna's 1,050,000) — 128,000 kept here as a deliberately conservative placeholder floor, not a real spec; raise it if a real source turns up. Pricing is also an unverified placeholder copied from gpt-4o. One of three gpt-5.6 variants (sol/terra/luna) in this account; no plain gpt-5.6 exists.

Third gpt-5.6 variant alongside sol/terra, added to try to beat sol's benchmark lead. Confirmed live via direct OpenAI API call: reasoning-family model, rejects non-default temperature (GrokChatClient self-heals by retrying without it). maxInputTokens=1,050,000 per published spec (largest of the three variants). Pricing is an unverified placeholder copied from gpt-4o — update when a real source is available.

xAI's actual latest generation, newer than grok-4.5 despite the lower-looking version number (4.20 > 4.5 as sequential minor releases, not decimals) — discovered via direct xAI model-list API call, not previously in this catalog. Its own aliases tag it beta/experimental (grok-4.20-beta, grok-4.20-experimental-beta-...), so treat results with more caution than the established grok-4/grok-4.5. Confirmed live: accepts temperature normally, but REJECTS reasoning_effort outright ("does not support parameter reasoningEffort", camelCase/no-underscore in the error text — GrokChatClient's self-heal matches both spellings) — it appears to always reason without an exposed effort dial. context_length confirmed 1,000,000 via API; pricing is an unverified placeholder copied from grok-4 (xAI's own price fields use an internal unit not yet decoded to $/M).
Wired via AnthropicChatClient.

Anthropic's flagship, one tier above claude-sonnet-5, added to try to beat gpt-5.6-sol's benchmark lead. Wired via AnthropicChatClient. Confirmed live via direct Anthropic API call: rejects temperature entirely like sonnet-5 (self-healed); supports adaptive thinking + output_config.effort for reasoningEffort. maxInputTokens/pricing are unverified placeholders copied from claude-sonnet-5 — update when a real source is available.

Wired via GeminiChatClient. Supports Native Multimodal MP4 Video Review. Was gemini-2.5-pro, which Google retired for new API keys (404 "no longer available to new users") — GeminiChatClient was already silently falling back to gemini-2.5-flash on that 404, so this just makes the catalog match what was actually running.

Wired via GeminiChatClient. Reasoning/"thinking" model per Google's own model metadata (thinking: true) — same class as OpenAI's o-series; watch for similar quirks (temperature/param rejection, thinking tokens counting toward output budget). Pricing copied from gemini-2.5-flash as a placeholder — not verified against a real source, update when known.

First Gemini Pro-tier model in this catalog — every other Gemini entry so far is Flash-tier. Added to try to beat gpt-5.6-sol's benchmark lead. Wired via GeminiChatClient. Confirmed live via direct Google API call: thinking:true, inputTokenLimit 1,048,576, outputTokenLimit 65,536; thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel confirmed up to "high" (Gemini's ceiling — no "max"/"xhigh" tier exists). "-preview" tag means Google could change or retire this id without notice; pricing copied from gemini-3.6-flash as a placeholder, not verified against a real source.
GrokVisionClient: book-page OCR, cast-on-image classify, and multi-image frame review.
Wired for clip/frame review via MultiProviderVisionClient (OCR/cast-classify stay Grok-only).

Wired for clip/frame review (CompleteWithImagesAsync) via MultiProviderVisionClient (OCR/cast-classify stay Grok-only). Was gemini-2.5-pro, retired by Google for new API keys — see the Chat entry's note.
Meta MusicGen model hosted on Fal.ai. Pure instrumental background scoring with zero vocal hallucination.
Udio model hosted on Fal.ai. High-fidelity 44.1kHz studio music scoring with rich dynamic range.
MiniMax Music model hosted on Fal.ai for cinematic themes and dynamic background scores.
Stability AI Stable Audio 2.0 hosted on Fal.ai with improved stereo width and multi-minute structural coherence.
Unofficial third-party Suno reseller (docs.sunoapi.org). Documented duration param is 10-360s on model V5_5 custom mode — the only audio provider here with real duration control.

A different unofficial Suno reseller (docs.aimusicapi.ai). No documented duration control — generates a full track at whatever length Suno produces (typically ~2-4 min); the client-side mix step trims to scene length.
Spoken dialogue from a personal clone sample on Cast.
Creates a voice profile from a short mic/upload sample (Cast → Voice clone sample). Optional paid add-on path.

Clones a voice from a reference sample (>=10s, reuses this project's existing assets/characters/{key}/voice_clone_sample.* upload) via Fal.ai's queue API (fal.ai/models/fal-ai/minimax/voice-clone). Input: audio_url (URL or data URI). Output: custom_voice_id, reused across many fal-ai/minimax/speech-02-hd calls so the clone cost is paid once. $1.50 per clone call — confirmed via fal.ai's own model/pricing page and openapi schema (2026-08). A preview-text option exists ($0.30/1000 chars) but this app's client never requests it. MiniMax retains the cloned voice only if used by a speech call at least once within 7 days of creation (provider-side retention, not enforced by this app).

Text-to-speech via Fal.ai's queue API (fal.ai/models/fal-ai/minimax/speech-02-hd) using a voice cloned by fal-ai/minimax/voice-clone (custom_voice_id passed as voice_setting.voice_id — confirmed against MiniMax's own platform.minimax.io voice-cloning docs, same convention). Input: text (max 5000 chars per call, this app does not auto-chunk longer narration), voice_setting {voice_id, speed 0.5-2.0, vol, pitch, emotion}. Output: audio.url + duration_ms. $0.10 per 1000 characters — confirmed via fal.ai's own model/pricing page (2026-08).

Sync Labs Lipsync 2 Pro via Fal.ai's queue API (fal.ai/models/fal-ai/sync-lipsync/v2/pro). Input: video_url, audio_url (both URL or data URI), optional sync_mode (cut_off default | loop | bounce | silence | remap) for when the two durations differ. Output: video.url. Zero-shot — no fine-tuning needed; preserves natural teeth/facial detail per Fal's own listing. ~$5/min of output video (~$0.083/s) — sourced via targeted search during research (fal.ai's own pricing page returned HTTP 429 rate-limiting when fetched directly; cross-checked against Sync Labs' own sync.so/pricing page, which lists the same figure for their Pro tier). Confirm against fal.ai's live pricing page before relying on this for a large narration/dub run.

Newest Sync Labs model on Fal.ai (fal.ai/models/fal-ai/sync-lipsync/v3), same core video_url/audio_url/sync_mode input as v2 Pro plus an optional `options` object (model_mode: lips/face/head/lipsync/emotion/talking_head, prompt: emotion tag, temperature, active_speaker_detection, occlusion_detection_enabled) that this app's client does not yet expose. Pricing not confirmed — fal.ai's pricing page returned HTTP 429 during research and no third-party source for v3 specifically was found; left null rather than guessed. Not the capability default until pricing is confirmed.
